summary: Backend-only verification of two production-log-driven fixes: (1) FIX 1 — GET /github/app/status refactored from sequential per-installation GitHub round-trips to bounded-concurrency (asyncio.gather + Semaphore(5)) to eliminate thundering-herd health-check timeouts; (2) FIX 2 — GET /github/oauth/repos now wraps gh_repos() in try/except httpx.HTTPStatusError so revoked/expired tokens produce clean 401/502 HTTPExceptions instead of raw 500 tracebacks. Executed the three requested pytest files (16 tests total) — all 16 PASSED in 1.00s. Backend supervisor status RUNNING, no startup exceptions (only benign idempotent TTL index warnings from init_prod_collections, pre-existing and unrelated).
critical_code_review_comments: FIX 1 correctly preserves per-row semantics (cache freshness check, DB persist, graceful fallback to previously-cached repos on error) while removing serial-await bottleneck. Semaphore(5) is a reasonable cap for GitHub API concurrency per user.
FIX 2 leaks no raw exception text; both 401 (expired connection) and 502 (upstream failure) messages are user-friendly.
New concurrency test asserts <1.2s for 10x 0.2s-latency installations — provides real regression protection against a future accidental revert to sequential loop.
Consider also asserting order-independence of results in the concurrency test (nice-to-have, not blocking).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both fixes verified. 5 pre-existing status tests + 2 new concurrency tests + 2 new oauth-repos error-handling tests + 7 pre-existing state-recovery tests all green. Backend boots cleanly under supervisor. No further action required for this round.
rca of the issue: FIX 1 RCA: sequential `for install in installations: await fetch()` combined with 10s cache TTL + ~2.5s frontend poll interval caused all installation caches to expire in same window; user with N installations (some dead => 404) generated N sequential GitHub round-trips per /status call, blocking the event loop long enough to make sibling /health probes exceed nginx upstream timeout (110). Mitigation: asyncio.gather with Semaphore(5) parallelizes fetches and isolates per-installation failures via return_exceptions/try-except in _resolve_row. FIX 2 RCA: unwrapped httpx.raise_for_status() on stale OAuth token propagated HTTPStatusError as raw 500. Mitigation: try/except at handler boundary translates GitHub 401 -> HTTPException(401 friendly), other -> 502.
